From \(4P = kQ = 10R\):
\[
P=\frac{10R}{4}=\frac{5R}{2},\qquad Q=\frac{10R}{k}
\]
R’s profit share:
\[
\frac{R}{P+Q+R}
=\frac{R}{\frac{5R}{2}+\frac{10R}{k}+R}
=\frac{1}{\frac72+\frac{10}{k}}
=\frac{6}{31}
\]
So:
\[
\frac72+\frac{10}{k}=\frac{31}{6}
\]
\[
\frac{10}{k}=\frac{31}{6}-\frac72=\frac{31}{6}-\frac{21}{6}=\frac{10}{6}=\frac53
\]
\[
k=10\cdot \frac35=6
\]

\[
\boxed{6}
\]
